lcc_original: 永恆主上帝用地上的塵土塑造了人【5】，將生氣吹進他的鼻孔裏，那人就成了一個有生命的活人。
notes: 永恆主 (Lü's rendering of YHWH) mapped to WH03068; 上帝 (Lü's 'God') mapped to WH0430.
WH04480 (מִן 'from') maps to 用 in both UNV and LCC, following UNV's precedent for this preposition in this phrase.
LCC 塑造了 (sculpted/formed) for יָצַר — SNs attached to the whole verb + aspect particle 了 as a unit.
吹進: SNs attach after 吹 (נָפַח root); directional complement 進 is a Chinese addition with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
UNV's 名叫亞當<WH0120> is a translator's gloss for the second הָאָדָם (subject of וַיְהִי). LCC uses 那人 in this role, so the second WH0120 maps to 那人.
一個 (Chinese numeral classifier 'a/one') has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
他的 (pronominal 'his') is the suffix implicit in WH0639 (אַפָּיו); left unannotated.
就 (Chinese sequential particle) and 將 (Classical Chinese pre-object marker) have no Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated.
Footnote marker 【5】 preserved in its original post-人 position.
